risk_summary: The excerpt is technically detailed and includes meaningful quantified results, but relies substantially on management estimates for loan losses, acquired-loan cash flows, goodwill, compensation, and taxes. Credit risk is evident from specific impairments, charge-offs, fraud-related losses, and purchased-credit-impaired loan provisions, although reported earnings and fee income trends are positive. Exclusion of non-core items and the truncated discussion limit assessment of underlying recurring profitability.
